description: Open-source CFD toolbox with a wide range of solvers and utilities for fluid dynamics simulations (ESI/OpenCFD MinGW native Windows build).
notes: This is the ESI/OpenCFD MinGW cross-compiled build of OpenFOAM.
Run 'openfoam' (or the Start Menu shortcut) to open the MSYS2 terminal with the OpenFOAM environment already set up.
This build can run solvers and utilities but cannot compile OpenFOAM or user code.
For parallel runs, install 'msmpi' from the main bucket.
For post-processing, install the Windows version of ParaView separately.

script: if ($proc.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "OpenFOAM installer failed with exit code $($proc.ExitCode)." }
